Then he copied the name into his logbook, lit the great lamp as he did every dusk, and let its beam carry the small, stubborn hope out across the dark water.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还沉在深蓝的睡意里。街灯昏黄，照着空荡的马路，偶尔一辆出租车驶过，留下一串湿漉漉的光。便利店的招牌固执地亮着，店员靠在柜台后打盹。环卫工推着车，扫帚划过地面，发出沙沙的轻响。高楼的窗大多黑着，只有零星几盏灯，像失眠的眼睛。天边泛起一线微白，鸟还没醒，风却先凉了。这是城市最安静的时刻，也是它悄悄换气、准备迎接又一个白昼的时刻。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a problem by calling a smaller version of itself.\n- Imagine standing in a line and asking the person ahead how many people are in front of them; they ask the next person, and so on until someone at the front says zero.\n- Each answer passes back up the line until you get your total, so a big job gets done by solving tiny copies of the same job."}
